title: Diversification and conservation of DNA binding specificities of SPL family of transcription factors
authors: Miaomiao Li; Tao Yao; Mary Galli; Luigi Franklin Di Costanzo; Wanru Lin; Yilin Zhou; Jin-Gui Chen; Andrea Gallavotti; Shao-shan Carol Huang
one_liner_zh: 该文通过DAP-seq和AlphaFold3建模研究拟南芥SPL转录因子家族DNA结合特异性的分化与保守，聚焦TF-DNA互作机制，方法含AI结构预测，高度匹配课题。
abstract: SQUAMOSA Promoter-Binding Protein-Like (SPL) transcription factors are key regulators of plant development and stress responses. Here, we present a comprehensive DNA affinity purification sequencing (DAP-seq) analysis of 14 of the 16 SPL members in Arabidopsis thaliana, revealing two major classes based on distinct DNA-binding motifs. Gene Ontology enrichment of target genes indicated both shared and specialized functions among AtSPLs, including roles in hormone signaling, metal ion homeostasis, and developmental transitions. Comparative analysis of closely related paralogs, AtSPL9 and AtSPL15, uncovered divergence in DNA-binding specificity and target gene regulation, particularly in auxin and abscisic acid pathways. We validated these differences using protoplast reporter assays and motif discovery. Extending our study across species, we analyzed DAP-seq data from maize (Zea mays) and wheat (Triticum aestivum) SPL homologs, identifying conserved target genes but species-specific DNA motifs. Notably, wheat SPLs preferentially bind to longer, palindromic motifs distinct from the GTAC core motif in Arabidopsis. Using AlphaFold3 structure modeling, we show that these motif differences may arise from enhanced protein-protein interactions that stabilize dimeric binding. Our results highlight how SPL family members diversify through DNA-binding evolution and suggest that transcription factor dimerization contributes to motif complexity and regulatory specialization across plant genomes.
abstract_zh: SQUAMOSA启动子结合蛋白样（SPL）转录因子是植物发育和胁迫反应的关键调控因子。在此，我们展示了对拟南芥（Arabidopsis thaliana）中16个SPL成员中14个进行的全面DNA亲和纯化测序（DAP-seq）分析，揭示了基于不同DNA结合基序的两大类。靶基因的基因本体论富集分析表明，AtSPLs具有共享和特化功能，包括在激素信号传导、金属离子稳态和发育转变中的作用。对紧密相关的旁系同源基因AtSPL9和AtSPL15的比较分析，揭示了DNA结合特异性和靶基因调控的差异，特别是在生长素和脱落酸通路中。我们通过原生质体报告基因实验和基序发现验证了这些差异。将研究扩展到跨物种层面，我们分析了玉米（Zea mays）和小麦（Triticum aestivum）SPL同源物的DAP-seq数据，识别出保守的靶基因但物种特异的DNA基序。值得注意的是，小麦SPLs优先结合与拟南芥中GTAC核心基序不同的更长回文基序。利用AlphaFold3结构建模，我们表明这些基序差异可能源于增强的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用，从而稳定二聚体结合。我们的结果突显了SPL家族成员如何通过DNA结合进化实现多样化，并提示转录因子二聚化有助于植物基因组中基序复杂性和调控特化。
